_comment: Copy this file to lint-rules.json (drop .example) and edit freely. scripts/lint.py reads lint-rules.json if present, falling back to this .example file otherwise, so the linter works out of the box before you customize it.
_flag_clipped_fragments_comment: Off by default. When true, flags 2+ consecutive sentences of 4 words or fewer as a staccato AI tell. Two short declarative sentences in a row are normal organizational prose, so only turn this on if your house style bans the rhythm.
_always_replace_comment: Platform-neutral AI-tell vocabulary. Matching is inflection-aware in the script (leverage also catches leveraging/leveraged). Add your own org-specific banned words here too.
_name_exempt_comment: Words in always_replace that collide with a common surname. The script flags only the lowercase verb, never a capitalized name.

naming_rules.message: example only — replace with your own org's naming rule (e.g., a defunct legal-entity form that should never appear in copy)

_naming_rules_comment: Org-specific naming mistakes that are always wrong — wrong conjunction/symbol, defunct legal name, disallowed nickname. 'pattern' is a Python regex; 'flags' is optional (i = case-insensitive). Delete the placeholder example above and add your own from the 'Not acceptable' list in SKILL.md's Organization Name Rules section.
